latestVersion.changelog:
genviral 1.0.0

- Initial release of full genviral Partner API automation.
- Create and schedule video or slideshow posts across TikTok, Instagram, and all supported platforms.
- Includes slideshow generation, CDN uploads, template/pack management, analytics, and content pipeline automation.
- Studio AI integration for image (sync) and video (async) generation.
- Supports niche research, performance tracking, and evolving hook/CTA library.
- All actions are fully auditable in the Genviral dashboard.
